headline: Suspected China-linked hackers let autonomous Cairn AI agents find and exploit a MONAI Label zero-day, taking root on a university server.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers now point autonomous frameworks like Cairn at targets, and the agents find unknown flaws and take root without a human driving each step.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Cairn Agents Exploit MONAI Label Zero-Day

topics.title: FBI Investigates Hack of NCIC Database
topics.latest_developments: The FBI opened an investigation into an apparent hack of the National Crime Information Center, the criminal justice database it maintains, an Associated Press source said.
topics.why_it_matters: NCIC moves records between local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies, so stolen or altered entries touch active cases across the country.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: This is the second reported intrusion into FBI systems in two months.

sources.title: FBI Investigating Apparent Hack of Its Key National Criminal Justice Database, AP Source Says
FBI reportedly hacked again, this time targeting nationwide police database

topics.title: OpenRouter Drops Three AI Inference Providers
topics.latest_developments: OpenRouter cut three AI inference providers from its routing pool after Dragos found attackers had stolen customer requests from inside them for months.
topics.why_it_matters: Prompts carry source code, credentials, and customer records, so a breached inference provider leaks the data enterprises assumed disappeared on arrival.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: Some stolen requests carried the Zero Data Retention flag, the setting that promises a prompt is never stored.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: Researchers planted 2 million trackable canary prompts into the AI supply chain and watched secret user data leak.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Inventory which downstream providers your AI gateway routes prompts to. Treat retention promises as unverified until the provider proves detection works.

sources.title: OpenRouter Drops 3 Providers After Researchers Catch Months of Prompt Theft at AI Hosting Firms
Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.

topics.title: pwn.ai Breaks Ghostscript Sandbox With Uploads
topics.latest_developments: Security firm pwn.ai showed that a crafted file escapes Ghostscript's security sandbox and runs commands on the server that processes it.
topics.why_it_matters: Linux servers call Ghostscript to convert uploaded PDFs, PostScript files, and images, often without the application knowing, so an ordinary upload form becomes the entry point.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Install the Ghostscript fix. Map which applications hand user-supplied documents to Ghostscript for conversion.

sources.title: Researchers Demonstrate Ghostscript Sandbox-Escape RCE via Crafted File Uploads in Popular Apps

topics.title: Cairn Agents Exploit MONAI Label Zero-Day
topics.latest_developments: Amazon Threat Intelligence pinned the agent-discovered flaw to MONAI Label 0.8.5 and earlier in default setups, where an attacker with no account writes files outside the storage folder.
topics.why_it_matters: Every internet-exposed MONAI Label server in that configuration offers suspected China-linked operators the same unauthenticated path to root that took a university server.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Locate MONAI Label deployments, move off 0.8.5 and earlier, and pull the servers off the public internet.

sources.title: Amazon: China-Linked Hackers’ AI Agents Exploited Medical Software Zero-Day
Attackers' AI Agents Found a Zero-Day in Medical-Imaging Software and Gained Root Access
Hackers use autonomous AI tool Cairn to find zero-day, take over server

topics.title: Signal Blocks AI Agents From Screenshotting Chats
topics.latest_developments: Signal will restrict screenshots by default on Android and iOS to stop AI agents from reading private chats, and calls the protection incomplete.
topics.why_it_matters: On-device agents read whatever the screen displays, so end-to-end encryption stops protecting a message the moment it renders.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: The restriction covers agentic systems built into iOS 27 and Android versions where Signal can detect an assistant trying to read the app.

sources.title: Signal Blocks AI Agents From Reading Private Chats via Screenshots on Android and iOS

topics.title: Trump Names Kirsten Davies National Cyber Director
topics.latest_developments: President Trump tapped Kirsten Davies, the Pentagon's chief information officer, as national cyber director, lifting her out of the acting role.
topics.why_it_matters: Davies will set White House cyber strategy, which the administration frames as America First, steering federal priorities for critical infrastructure owners and their vendors.

details.label: Flashback
details.text: Davies took the job in an acting capacity after Sean Cairncross left the White House.

sources.title: President Trump Taps Kirsten Davies as National Cyber Director

topics.title: Com Affiliates Steal Cloud Data by Phone
topics.latest_developments: Unit 42 detailed how Com affiliates phone employees at healthcare and finance firms, hijack their accounts, and pull data out of cloud services for extortion.
topics.why_it_matters: Voice phishing walks past technical controls and reaches cloud stores holding patient and customer records within hours of a single successful call.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Harden help desk identity checks before any password or multifactor reset. Alert on bulk downloads from cloud data stores.

sources.title: Dialing for Data: Inside the Com’s High-Profile Heists

topics.title: Bazuka Malware Adds LLM Control to Android
topics.latest_developments: ThreatFabric disclosed Bazuka, an Android malware framework that wires large language models into victim management and hides credential theft behind fake screen overlays.
topics.why_it_matters: The overlays capture banking logins while operators drive the phone remotely, handing attackers accounts, messages, and transaction approvals from one infection.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: The framework surfaced in late October 2026 during an investigation into an NFC-relay banking trojan.

sources.title: Bazuka Android Malware Uses Fake Screen Overlays to Hide Credential Theft and Device Control

topics.title: NSA Resumes Operations After Network Disruption
topics.latest_developments: The National Security Agency resumed normal operations after days of disruption on its internal networks, and kept certain facilities under Code Orange.
topics.why_it_matters: Delayed openings and supervisor check-ins for non-essential employees show the agency has not fully closed out the incident.

sources.title: NSA resumes normal operations following internal network disruptions

business_politics.title: Ukraine Blamed for Ship Attack in Finnish Waters
business_politics.latest_developments: Finland's prime minister attributed Saturday's drone attack on a sanctioned Russian cargo ship, left ablaze in Finnish waters, to Ukraine, saying war is spilling over into Finland's immediate vicinity.
business_politics.why_it_matters: An attack inside the waters of NATO member Finland pulls the Russia-Ukraine war into the Baltic and raises escalation risk for the alliance.

sources.title: Sanctioned Russian vessel ablaze in Finnish waters after drone attack

business_politics.title: Argentina's Borrowing Costs Jump Before Milei's Bid
business_politics.latest_developments: Argentine borrowing costs jumped as President Javier Milei's approval ratings slid and investors questioned his financing plans ahead of his re-election bid, the Financial Times reported Sunday, November 22.
business_politics.why_it_matters: Rising yields make Argentina's debt rollovers more expensive and test investor patience with Milei's libertarian program.

sources.title: Argentina's borrowing costs jump as Milei's falling popularity rattles investors

business_politics.title: U.A.E. Shuttles Oil Past Iranian Forces
business_politics.latest_developments: The United Arab Emirates is shuttling oil past Iranian forces in the Strait of Hormuz with United States military help, the Wall Street Journal reported Saturday, November 21.
business_politics.why_it_matters: Keeping crude moving through Hormuz holds down oil prices and limits the damage Iran's strikes do to Gulf exports.

details.label: Flashback
details.text: Volumes shipped through Hormuz have fallen as Iranian strikes increase. One analyst told the Financial Times the recovery in Middle Eastern crude exports looks increasingly fragile.

sources.title: The U.A.E. Is Shuttling Oil Past Iran in Risky Hormuz Operation
Oil shipped through Hormuz falls as Iranian strikes increase

business_politics.title: Anthropic's Debut Sours Amid AI Selloff
business_politics.latest_developments: Anthropic shares slid in their second trading day to within 5 cents of the $83 offering price, and recriminations over the deal began, the Wall Street Journal reported.
business_politics.why_it_matters: The weakest start for the largest initial public offering on record signals investors will no longer fund artificial-intelligence growth at any price.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: The Wall Street Journal put last week's wipeout in artificial-intelligence shares at $4 trillion. Anthropic's listing failed to slow the selling.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: The Financial Times asked whether Anthropic and its bankers erred by hastily exercising the greenshoe option to issue more stock.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: The rout now resembles the bursting of the dot-com bubble, the Journal wrote Sunday, November 22.

sources.title: The Blame Game Has Begun Over Anthropic's Turbulent Trading Debut
Anthropic's IPO Turmoil Caps $4 Trillion AI Wipeout on Wall Street
Did Anthropic and its bankers get a key call wrong after IPO?
Has the AI Bubble Already Burst?

business.title: Education Tops Reuse Ideas for New Kensington Campus
business.latest_developments: Two studies of community engagement and real estate found education remains the favored reuse for Penn State New Kensington's Upper Burrell campus, which shuts down in the spring.
business.why_it_matters: The findings steer who buys the Upper Burrell site and whether the Alle-Kiski Valley keeps a higher education presence.

sources.title: Penn State New Kensington community engagement, real estate studies show that education remains a favored reuse option

business.title: Westmoreland Leans on Reserves for $452 Million Budget
business.latest_developments: Westmoreland County commissioners would cover part of their proposed $452 million 2027 budget by drawing down the county's fund balance, a TribLive editorial argued Sunday, November 22.
business.why_it_matters: Spending reserves holds county taxes steady now and leaves Westmoreland County a thinner cushion for future shortfalls.

sources.title: Editorial: Westmoreland commissioners rely on easy out with fund balance

around_town.title: Norwin Hires Irwin Officer as Resource Officer
around_town.latest_developments: The Norwin School District hired an Irwin police officer as a school resource officer, and the Irwin department now looks to hire new officers, TribLive reported Sunday, November 22.
around_town.why_it_matters: Norwin's schools gain a dedicated officer while Irwin's police department recruits to refill its ranks.

sources.title: Norwin hires Irwin cop as school resource officer; Irwin seeks new officers

around_town.title: Light Up Night Fills Downtown Pittsburgh
around_town.latest_developments: Thousands packed downtown streets Saturday night, November 21, for the 65th annual Highmark Light Up Night, with tree lightings and ice skating opening Pittsburgh's holiday season.
around_town.why_it_matters: The night marks the official start of the holiday shopping season in downtown Pittsburgh.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: The City of Pittsburgh sent violence prevention workers through the crowds alongside police as families gathered, WPXI reported.

sources.title: Downtown Pittsburgh becomes winter wonderland during 65th annual Light Up Night
Pittsburgh celebrates 65 years of Light Up Night
City of Pittsburgh steps up violence prevention during Light Up Night

around_town.title: Warm Sunday Yields to Thanksgiving Travel Storm
around_town.latest_developments: Pittsburgh climbs into the mid-60s Sunday, November 22, its last warm day before overnight showers and a cooler stretch next week, KDKA, WPXI, and WTAE all reported.
around_town.why_it_matters: Travelers leaving Pittsburgh for the Atlantic Seaboard next week face delays as a coastal storm now flooding Florida tracks north.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Torrential rain closed roads, flooded homes, and forced high-water rescues along Florida's Atlantic coast, WTAE reported, with the threat unfolding over several days.

sources.title: Pittsburgh: One more warm day
Intense flooding, developing storm could snarl Thanksgiving travel on the East Coast
Pittsburgh will have one more day of 60-degree temperatures before the weather cools off
One final warm fall day before cool stretch settles in
Western PA: Showers overnight then a cooldown

around_town.title: City Mission Hands Out Thanksgiving Boxes
around_town.latest_developments: City Mission in Washington, Pennsylvania, held its annual Boxes of Love distribution Friday, November 20, giving community members a turkey and a box of Thanksgiving side dishes.
around_town.why_it_matters: The giveaway puts a full holiday dinner on the table for Washington County families who cannot buy one.

sources.title: 'Boxes of Love': City Mission in Washington helps local families in need with Thanksgiving dinner

around_teams.title: SNR Drive Picks the Eagles Game
around_teams.latest_developments: Matt Williamson and Wes Uhler gave their predictions for the Steelers' trip to the Philadelphia Eagles on SNR Drive, which the team posted Saturday night, November 21.
around_teams.why_it_matters: Pittsburgh plays at Philadelphia Sunday, November 22, at 1 p.m. Eastern on CBS.

sources.title: Steelers Vs Eagles Predictions | SNR Drive (Nov.20) | Pittsburgh Steelers

team_usa.title: Manchester United Eye Fullback Antonee Robinson
team_usa.latest_developments: Fulham left back Antonee Robinson, a United States men's national team starter, has drawn reported interest from Manchester United, ESPN's Transfer Talk said Sunday, November 22.
team_usa.why_it_matters: A move would put Robinson under Mauricio Pochettino, the coach who just left the United States job for Old Trafford.

sources.title: Transfer rumors, news: Antonee Robinson latest USMNT star linked with Man United

team_usa.title: Kansas City Current Win First NWSL Title
team_usa.latest_developments: The Kansas City Current beat the Washington Spirit 2-1 Saturday, November 21, for their first National Women's Soccer League Championship, sealed by a Vanessa DiBernardo strike.
team_usa.why_it_matters: The Spirit lost a third straight final, and forward Trinity Rodman said this defeat hurt the most.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: DiBernardo scored direct from a corner kick, an Olimpico that put her on ESPN's list of the best alongside Megan Rapinoe and Christian Pulisic.

sources.title: Kansas City wins 1st NWSL Championship as Rodman, Spirit lose 3rd straight final
